correctness.rationale: All locally square-free four-words are edges of a balanced strongly connected directed graph. The q=3 induced-subgraph argument, extended through intersecting 3-symbol subsets, proves strong connectivity for every q >=3. Exact coordinate elimination to K(x), the complete ordered-pair decomposition, and an explicit 2x2 determinant yield the full characteristic polynomial for every q. Matrix-tree and BEST theorems count rotation classes. Direct exhaustive q=3 Euler tours and independent exact Laplacian computations for q=3..6 match the symbolic formula; finite checks are explicitly separate from proof.

value.rationale: All length-four locally square-free patterns form the first natural word family forbidding both length-one and length-two squares. The theorem determines the entire number of cyclic enumerations for all alphabet sizes rather than a single existence construction or an arbitrary finite slice. A nontrivial quadratic/cubic Laplacian spectral decomposition exposes the alphabet dependence and yields exact counts for scheduling and constrained-word combinatorics.
